title: EHR Database Servers Unreachable — Ransom Note Found

fields.location: ORRMC-SQL01 and ORRMC-SQL02 (Data Center, Tower A)
fields.subject: ORRMC-SQL01 and ORRMC-SQL02 unreachable; ransom note on ORRMC-SQL01 console
fields.description: ORRMC-SQL01 and ORRMC-SQL02 are unreachable from the application servers ORRMC-EHR-APP01 to -APP04. The interface engine service on ORRMC-INT01 is stopped. A text file named READ_ME_NOW.txt is on the console of ORRMC-SQL01: it says the EHR database is encrypted, names a Tor address and gives 72 hours. I have not touched either server.

activity.author: IT On-Call Engineer Dmitri Volkov
activity.text: Confirmed EHR database servers unresponsive. Interface engine ORRMC-INT01 stopped. Read file on ORRMC-SQL01 console: contains ransom note, Tor address, 72-hour deadline. No access to logs or network telemetry from console. Left servers untouched as per protocol.

activity.author: System
activity.text: Ticket created from incoming call to IT service desk (ext. 5-0100).

activity.author: System
activity.text: Priority escalated to Critical based on system-wide EHR impact.

instructorNote: This is a Cyber 1-level incident; the ISO must immediately open the incident log, call the Director of IT, and escalate to the AOC for HCC activation. The ticket’s description confirms full EHR downtime and a ransom note.
